issues.description: The solution's Developer.attend method signature does not match the problem description and the template. The problem statement and template expect an instance method attend(course:) taking a single parameter of type Course?. However, the solution implements attend(course: Course?, forCredit: Bool) (an extra Boolean parameter). This also causes an internal inconsistency in the solution: Client.main() calls myself.attend(course: swiftCourse) with a single argument, which does not match the solution's two-parameter method and would fail to compile. Students following the template or tests will implement attend(course:) with one parameter and will be confused by the solution's differing signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signatures consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) change the solution to implement attend(course: Course?) with a single optional Course parameter (remove the extra forCredit: Bool parameter) so it matches the problem statement, template, and the Client call; or (B) update the problem statement, template, and Client to require attend(course: Course?, forCredit: Bool) and adjust tests accordingly. Prefer option (A) to preserve the stated exercise requirements.

issues.description: The problem statement and template define a Developer instance method attend(course:) that accepts a single optional Course parameter. The solution implementation changes the method signature to attend(course:forCredit:), adding an extra parameter (forCredit) that is not present in the problem description or template. This parameter mismatch breaks the direct mapping between the required API and the provided solution reference, creating confusion about the expected method signature and how students should implement or call it.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's attend method match the problem and template by removing the extra parameter: change the solution signature to func attend(course: Course?) { ... } (and adapt its implementation accordingly). Alternatively, if the extra parameter is required, update the problem statement and template to specify attend(course:forCredit:) with a clear description and usage, or provide a default value (forCredit: Bool = false) to preserve compatibility.
